findings.title: Codex WebSocket execution bypasses the request declaration table

concrete_reproduction.state: Use the opt-in Codex WebSocket executor selected by CodexAutoExecutor for a downstream WebSocket request.
concrete_reproduction.wrong_collision_result: CodexWebsocketsExecutor.Execute dialed and sent to the upstream test server, then returned nil error; expected a local HTTP 400 invalid_request_error with code tool_name_collision and zero network requests.
concrete_reproduction.restoration_input: Declare namespace repo/read and return a Codex function_call named repo__read from the WebSocket upstream.
concrete_reproduction.wrong_restoration_result: Both non-streaming and streaming WebSocket responses retained name repo__read and omitted namespace repo; expected exact original name read plus namespace repo.

adversarial_proof: TestReviewCodexWebsocketCollisionReachesNetwork failed: Execute() error = <nil>, while the test server observed the WebSocket connection/request.
TestReviewCodexWebsocketDoesNotRestoreDeclarationIdentity failed: output.0.name was repo__read instead of read and namespace was absent.
TestReviewCodexWebsocketStreamDoesNotRestoreDeclarationIdentity failed: streamed output_item.done and response.completed retained repo__read.
findings.coverage_gap: The added executor tests exercise CodexExecutor HTTP Execute and ExecuteStream only; no test covers the CodexAutoExecutor/CodexWebsocketsExecutor route.

findings.title: Custom-tool streaming restoration leaves function argument events and stale item IDs

upstream_sequence: response.output_item.added with item type function_call, id fc_1, name patch
response.output_item.done and response.completed for the same call
concrete_reproduction.wrong_result: RestoreResponsesToolCalls rewrote the added/done/completed items to custom_tool_call and changed their ID to ctc_1, but passed through response.function_call_arguments.delta/done with item_id fc_1. The resulting stream has mismatched IDs and function event types for a custom call instead of matching response.custom_tool_call_input events referencing ctc_1.

findings.adversarial_proof: TestReviewCodexHTTPStreamCustomCallKeepsMismatchedFunctionArgumentEvents failed with an output_item.added id ctc_1 followed by response.function_call_arguments.delta/done using item_id fc_1.
findings.coverage_gap: The new streaming test covers only a namespaced function call; custom streaming deltas/done events and cross-event item-ID consistency are not tested.

defects_reproduced: WebSocket collision reached network and returned no local collision error
WebSocket non-stream response did not restore namespace/name
WebSocket stream did not restore namespace/name
HTTP custom stream produced mismatched custom item IDs and function argument event types

review_summary: Evidence integrity, exact scope, forward/reverse application, reconstructed trees, file hashes, mandated tests, and race suites were independently reproduced. The slice is rejected because the active Codex WebSocket execution route bypasses declaration collision enforcement and identity restoration, and because HTTP custom-tool streaming creates internally inconsistent event types and item IDs.
